notes:
# Events that ask who is joining really are joined now {doc}
Your name and email go into the form, the button gets pressed, and the event
opens in Zoom — about fifteen seconds from the page appearing, with nobody
in the room.

# It no longer starts over {refresh}
Submitting the form takes the event to another of its own pages. The app
used to read that as having lost the page, reopen the original link, and
blank the form it had just filled in.

---

Everything else in this release:

- An event whose only way in is "Agree and join" is recognised as a way in,
  whatever its capitals.
- A form is only submitted once every field reads back as typed. It used to
  count one field of three as filled and press the button anyway.
- Chrome's address suggestions no longer hide the page from the app, or sit
  in front of the button it is trying to press.
- A lobby that gives up now says what the page was offering, so an event
  that words its button differently can be fixed quickly.
